paper_metadata.title: Accelerating the design of multivariate Nb-Si based alloys with excellent strength and toughness matching through machine learning

evidence.quote: The applications of Nb-Si-based alloys for new-generation engines are heavily influenced by their strength and toughness.

machine_learning_models.name: Random Forest Regression
machine_learning_models.task: predict fracture toughness of Nb-Si-based alloys from alloying element compositions
machine_learning_models.dataset: 259 arc-melted Nb-Si-based alloy samples with fracture toughness data

evidence.quote: The result indicated that Random Forest (RF) and K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) regression models were suitable for predicting Nb-Si-based alloys’ fracture toughness and compressive strength, respectively
The RF model was more accurate in predicting the fracture toughness of Nb-Si-based alloys, with the prediction accuracy of R2 = 0.813, MAE = 1.12 MPa ⋅ m1/2, and RMSE = 1.50 MPa ⋅ m1/2.

machine_learning_models.name: K-Nearest Neighbors Regression
machine_learning_models.task: predict compressive strength of Nb-Si-based alloys from alloying element compositions

evidence.quote: The result indicated that Random Forest (RF) and K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) regression models were suitable for predicting Nb-Si-based alloys’ fracture toughness and compressive strength, respectively

Among the six prediction models, the KNN model demonstrated the highest accuracy in predicting the compressive strength of Nb-Si-based alloys, with a prediction accuracy of R2 = 0.786, MAE = 132.21 MPa, RMSE = 190.79 MPa.
